title: The agent server and skill come inside Photonz and install with one command
goal: Someone who has the Photonz app and an agent tool on their Mac, but not the Photonz source, can let the agent drive Photonz with one command they copy from inside the app. Today the server and skill only install from a checkout of the source, so only the person who builds Photonz can use them.
notes: Focus success gap: agent-mcp success says 'installs with one command'; today that command is Scripts/install-mcp.sh in a checkout (lines 39 and 44: claude mcp add plus a skill link). docs/design/agent-mcp.md 'Not in this slice' (line 392-397): shipping the bridge inside the app bundle. Rough lines in queue/audits/2026-10-19-agent-skill.json ('The install is a developer's') and 2026-10-19-agent-mcp-reach-read-see.json ('builds a small helper program the first time, about 4 seconds'). Skill at plugin/skills/photonz/SKILL.md, plugin/.mcp.json. The channel already listens in every build (agent-mcp.md:34-41, release.sock, dev.sock, probe.sock). Scripts/build-app.sh must copy and sign the helper; never touch dist/Photonz Dev.app from a runner, use the probe.
acceptance: The small server program and the Photonz skill ship inside the app bundle (release, Dev and Probe builds), signed with the app, and codesign --verify --deep passes on the bundle
The one command to register them is shown in one place inside the app, with a Copy button. Place it by the placement contract (recommended: Settings, an Agents section); log why

From a folder with no Photonz source, a fresh agent session registered with that command reads the open document and renders a picture from the probe, proved in the audit with the command and the output pasted
Scripts/install-mcp.sh keeps working for developers and points at the same server; removing works too
The first run builds nothing (today it compiles a helper for about 4 seconds)

Copy is short and plain, no em dashes, no vendor names. Shipped behind next-agent-channel at Next defaults; try path: Settings, copy the command, run it, ask the agent to describe the open picture. Audit written under queue/audits/. Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
